'''Ara''' was [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] taken from her primitive [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Her master, [[Deezoth Caraz]], was killed at [[Ord Mynock Freeport]] while transporting her and another slave, [[Kema Forge]].

==Biography==
Ara was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] from a primitive [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was located far away from the regularly traveled [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]]. A healer to her people, she was captured by [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] and put in the custody of [[Deezoth Caraz]] and his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Vok]] to be given to a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] along with another [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] named [[Kema Forge]].<ref name="Game" />

During the trip, the group stopped on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]] where Ara was put to work getting drinks for Caraz. She desperately wanted to escape, and was fascinated by [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] she had been exposed to. She tried to convince Forge to help her.<ref name="Game" />

==Personality and traits==
While being from a primitive world, Ara was very curious and interested in exploring the galaxy. She was considered a healer among her people.<ref name="Game" />
